name: BlockBlasters
detailed_description:
In BlockBlasters, the crabs have taken over—and it's up to you to fight back. This fast-paced, action-packed 2D platformer drops you into a world where monstrous crabs are causing chaos. Armed with nothing but your trusty blaster and quick reflexes, you’ll need to blast, dodge, and survive to take back control.

As you move through each chaotic area, you’ll face off against increasingly challenging waves of these creepy, relentless creatures. Whether you’re leaping across platforms or diving into intense shootouts, every moment will keep you on the edge of your seat. Your blaster can be upgraded, giving you more firepower and new abilities to tackle the crab menace in different ways. But beware—these crabs aren't just mindless enemies. They’re tough, fast, and will stop at nothing to make your life difficult.

The gameplay combines classic platforming with intense combat, requiring a balance of precision jumping, fast reflexes, and strategic thinking. Each battle is a test of how well you can move, shoot, and react under pressure. You’ll need to adapt to new challenges as the waves of enemies evolve, keeping you on your toes from start to finish.

Whether you’re a fan of retro-style platformers or just looking for a fun, action-filled challenge, BlockBlasters offers a thrilling ride from beginning to end. So grab your blaster, jump in, and see if you’ve got what it takes to survive!

Key Features:

  • Intense 2D platforming action with fast-paced combat

  • Tight, responsive controls that make movement and combat feel fluid

  • Retro-inspired visuals and sound design that enhance the nostalgic feel

The game is still under development. There is many bugs and it is not yet fully completed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD FX-4350 or Intel Core i5-4460
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 280X or GeForce GTX 760
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD FX-6300 or Intel Core i5-4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 290 or GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
